# Draft:Samin Iqbal Sohrawardi Srabon

----
Samin Iqbal Sohrawardi Srabon is a young generation rising politician in Bnagladesh. He was born in a highly politically recognized family in Rangpur in 18 August, 2010. His father is Zahid Iqbal Sohrawardi( former Upazila Chairman Of Rajarhat Upazila and former President of Rangpur Chatroleague) . His mother is Ranu Begum. His childhood passed in a small city of Kurigram, named Rajarhat. He studied at Shishu Niketon Rajarhat. His grandfather was the former Member of Parliament in Bangladesh and the president and founder of Awami League In Rajarhat Upazila. He was also the Head Master of Rajarhat Pilot High School and a honorable Freedom Fighter. His Uncle Zaved Sohrawardi Opu was a famous politician, who was known to be a loyal Awami League leadesrs in Russia. Following his father and grandfathera legacy, Srabon wanta to be a great politician in future, idolizing Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. He is known as a rising young star in the region by taking his name "Sohrawardi" to the light. His other uncle, Razon Asif was the Rajarhat Awami League’s president and the head principal of Rajarhat Mohilla Degree College. His great grandfather Shakhwat Hossain Mondol is recognized as a landlord of the Upazila. His father was elected 2nd time as an Upazila Chairman in Rajarhat and was 2 times the Union Chairman, of Chakir Poshar Taluk. His grandmother Shamsunnahar Sohrawardi was also a social worker for poor and damaged people in the area.
